name: tiao-mobile
description: Capacitor wrapper for the Tiao Android + iOS apps.

scripts.cap:sync: pnpm run mobile:version && pnpm run build:client && cap sync
scripts.cap:run:ios: pnpm run cap:sync && cap run ios
scripts.cap:run:android: bash -c 'source scripts/android-env.sh && pnpm run build:client && cap sync android && cap run android'
scripts.build:ios:release: bash -c 'echo "Signed iOS builds run in CI (.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml). Locally: pnpm run cap:sync, then archive in Xcode. See docs/releasing-mobile.md."'
scripts.android:logcat: bash -c 'source scripts/android-env.sh && adb logcat -s Capacitor Capacitor/Console Capacitor/WebView chromium'
scripts.test:release: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs scripts/release/*.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/release -p '*_test.py' && bash scripts/test-ios-routes.sh
